info.title: OB Data Orch first vertical slice API
info.description: Structural and security-boundary contract for the private ODP, single-table CSV export slice. It does not make real execution available.

x-authentication-blocker: Browser identity provider, initial administrator and recovery identity remain deployment blockers.

get.description: OBDUMPER_EXPORT 只返回管理状态为 ENABLED 的任务候选。DATA_SOURCE_CONNECTION_TEST 是独立诊断筛选，可返回具备当前受认证 Agent 事实的 DISABLED 或 ENABLED 节点，但拒绝 MAINTENANCE/ARCHIVED；诊断候选不表示节点可接收导出任务。

post.description: G2 创建节点的固定本机配置声明。服务端固定将新节点保存为 DISABLED；首次关联后的 Agent 必须在本机复核工具、Java 和数据目录，浏览器不能写入心跳、资源采样或管理状态。

patch.description: G2 替换节点名称、目标平台、工具目录、Java 路径和导出数据目录；配置变化会使节点禁用并要求 Agent 重新核验。管理状态、Agent、心跳和资源事实不可写。

delete.description: 存在 Agent、草稿、预检查、任务、执行记录或连接测试引用时仅归档；完全未引用的节点才物理删除。归档会原子撤销当前 Agent 身份和未使用注册码；有运行任务时拒绝处置，避免中断任务回报。控制面不披露具体引用事实。

post.description: 节点管理员签发一次性关联材料。该操作没有请求体；材料只在 201 响应中展示一次，响应丢失后必须重新签发。
节点管理员请求当前受认证 Agent 执行唯一固定本机运行时检查。控制面只随心跳返回不透明检查标识；不下发路径、命令、SQL、凭据或工具输出。请求会使节点保持 DISABLED，直到检查通过后由专用启用动作完成状态转换。
仅当当前 Agent 在线、平台匹配、容量可用，且同一 factsRevision 的固定环境检查为 TOOL_RUNTIME_READY 时启用节点。该动作不连接数据库、不启动 OBDUMPER，任务仍须通过独立预检查。
浏览器只选择已授权的执行节点。控制面冻结数据源、凭据修订、节点事实和受认证 Agent 绑定，不直接连接数据库。G2 合成结果不能启用数据源。

get.description: 仅返回当前数据源对象范围内、单个执行节点的无秘密测试投影。它不表示其他节点、对象权限、性能或导出可行性。

post.description: Returns the authorized command preview with all non-password arguments and the fixed -p ****** password placeholder. Password secret resolution is forbidden; the executable argv contains neither a password value nor -p because the official security file supplies it.
Windows 本机 MVP：仅当冻结草稿绑定的预检查仍完整成功时创建任务。提交本身不接收命令、路径或密码；关联 Agent 领取后才会按固定 OBDUMPER_EXPORT 信封启动工具。

get.description: 只返回当前主体创建或通过 TASK_OPERATE_BY_DATA_SOURCE 明确授权的已提交任务。limit 只允许 10、20 或 50，默认 10；totalPages 仅按同一授权范围和当前 limit 派生，不返回全局任务总数。首个 F3 增量没有可靠阶段或百分比证据，因此明确返回 UNAVAILABLE；不返回配置、命令、日志、错误原文、凭据引用或创建者标识。
任务详情页头的授权最小标识。执行状态、配置快照和命令证据必须分别读取，不能借概览响应取得。
当前单表 CSV 切片的最小冻结配置事实；不返回完整快照 JSON、凭据引用、输出路径或日志路径。
只返回脱敏计划命令；不回退为实际 argv、秘密槽位或进程事件载荷。
只返回平台已确认的状态和时间事实。阶段、进度、原始执行事件与结果摘要未形成可靠安全投影前不得返回。
只读取当前已授权任务的已持久化双层秘密脱敏日志。正文保留完整非秘密运行上下文，包括连接、对象、路径、非密码命令令牌和工具诊断；密码、令牌、密钥和安全材料继续遮蔽。cursor 继续固定快照；after 从最后可靠游标创建新快照增量读取；两者不能同时提供。响应不含总数、段路径、SQLite 行号或来源内部标识。
仅活动任务的单向 SSE。正文与日志查询使用同一秘密脱敏边界，保留非秘密运行上下文。after 或 Last-Event-ID 必须是同一主体和任务的最后可靠游标；每个 log 事件只代表已 fsync 且已登记的单条记录。连接恢复不代表 Agent 采集缺口已补齐。

post.description: 已确认的后续下载契约；F3.3 不实现该端点，不能将其视为可用能力。
当前已关联 Agent 只能回传固定本机运行时检查的 PASSED/TOOL_RUNTIME_READY 或 FAILED 稳定码；请求不包含路径、命令、数据库信息、秘密或原始错误。
A durable no-body source gap created when the Agent log spool reaches its fixed limit. It cannot carry log text, command, path, raw error or secret.
G2 固定 EXPORT_PREFLIGHT 的服务端原子领取。请求不接受预检查标识、租约标识、秘密、任意 SQL、路径或工具命令；204 表示当前没有可领取工作且不产生副作用，真实执行保持关闭。
仅受认证 Agent 可在已确认的固定 EXPORT_PREFLIGHT 租约中解析唯一数据库连接槽位。响应只能短时进入 Agent 内存，不得进入状态文件、日志、审计、浏览器或任务快照；该合成协议不开放真实执行。
受认证 Agent 原子领取已绑定到自身节点的一条基础连接测试。请求不接受测试标识、租约、地址、凭据、SQL、路径或命令；204 不产生副作用。
仅当前受认证 Agent 可在确认后的有效连接测试租约内解析唯一数据库连接槽位。响应只短时进入 Agent 内存，禁止持久化、回显、记录或用于导出执行。

BrowserSession.name: __Host-ob_data_orch_session
BrowserSession.description: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite browser session. Identity provider and initial administrator integration are not defined by this contract.

AgentCredential.description: Revocable opaque machine credential generated and protected by the Agent. Never accepted in a URL.

TaskPageSize.name: limit
TaskPageSize.description: Authorized task list page size. The server rejects all other values.

TaskLogAfter.name: after
TaskLogAfter.description: Opaque, subject- and task-bound last reliable log cursor.

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: The same opaque last reliable log cursor used by SSE reconnection.

DataSourceDeletion.description: Data source was physically deleted or archived to preserve history.

ExecutionNodeDeletion.description: Execution node was physically deleted or archived to preserve history; archived nodes may report that current Agent access was revoked.

Collection.description: Authorized cursor page without a global count.

TaskList.description: Authorization-scoped task page with list-safe fields and authorization-scoped totalPages only.

TaskOverviewRead.description: Authorized task overview without snapshot, command or execution fields.

TaskSnapshotRead.description: Authorized minimum immutable task snapshot without raw JSON, paths or credential references.

TaskCommandEvidenceRead.description: Authorized password-redacted planned command evidence without executable argv or secret slots.

TaskExecutionRead.description: Authorized confirmed execution state without raw process or result evidence payloads.

PrecheckRead.description: Authorized fixed precheck state with six redacted result codes. A pending lease projects all checks as UNKNOWN and never implies success or real execution.

DataSourceConnectionTestAccepted.description: Node-bound connection test accepted or safely replayed. It is only a G2 protocol request until an AGENT_JDBC terminal result is recorded.

DataSourceConnectionTestRead.description: Authorized, node-specific connection test state without connection identity, JDBC metadata, exception text or secret data.

AgentExecutionLogAppendAccepted.description: A confirmed or idempotently duplicated log batch. The response echoes the exact stream, sequence range and digest that the Agent must match before deleting its local batch.

AgentExecutionLogGapAccepted.description: A confirmed or idempotently duplicated no-body log gap. The response echoes the exact source range and normalized gap digest before the Agent may delete its local gap entry.

EnrollmentMaterialIssued.description: One-time enrollment material displayed only in this response.

AgentEnrollmentAccepted.description: Enrollment exchange accepted without echoing either input secret.

AgentPrecheckClaimed.description: Fixed EXPORT_PREFLIGHT lease was issued with immutable binding and check set; no real execution is enabled.

AgentPrecheckLeaseAcknowledged.description: Agent acknowledged the fixed precheck lease; no real execution is enabled.

AgentPrecheckSecretSlotResolved.description: Agent-only, no-store database connection slot response for one verified precheck lease. It does not authorize an execution or a tool start.

AgentPrecheckCompleted.description: Fixed precheck results were accepted as SUCCEEDED or FAILED; no real execution is enabled.

AgentDataSourceConnectionTestClaimed.description: A fixed node-bound connection-test lease was issued. No export execution is enabled.

AgentDataSourceConnectionTestLeaseAcknow.description: The Agent acknowledged the immutable connection-test lease.

AgentDataSourceConnectionTestSecretSlotR.description: One Agent-only, no-store database connection slot for the current confirmed connection-test lease.

AgentDataSourceConnectionTestCompleted.description: The fixed node-side connection result was accepted. G2 synthetic success still cannot enable a data source.

NoWork.description: No eligible work is currently available.

EventStream.description: Persisted log events after double secret redaction. Authorized task readers retain non-secret operational context; each log event has an opaque reliable cursor as its SSE id, and heartbeats contain no log content.

Download.description: Synchronous task-authorized log download after double secret redaction, retaining non-secret operational context; limited to 100000 records and 100 MiB.

Error.description: Stable safe error. Unauthorized objects use 404 semantics.

OpaqueId.description: New control-plane resource IDs and response requestId values use canonical lower-case UUIDv4. Agent v1 accepts already-persisted opaque identifiers only for recovery compatibility; it never rewrites them in place.

ExecutionNodeWrite.description: 节点注册界面的一次性完整替换输入。工具目录、Java 路径和导出数据目录均为目标机器绝对路径声明；首次关联 Agent 会在本机复核并固化，不能从心跳或后续控制面请求动态覆盖。

compatibilityMode.description: OceanBase MySQL 或 OceanBase Oracle 数据源类型。

DataSourceWrite.description: 连接串只能在浏览器中解析回填，控制面只接收结构化的 ODP 主机、端口、集群、租户、用户名和密码。创建固定为 DISABLED；启用和禁用只能通过专用状态动作完成。Patch 使用字段存在语义，省略密码表示保持不变。

DataSourceConnectionTestRequest.description: 浏览器只能选择一个已授权的候选执行节点。连接地址、用户名、密码、URL、命令和 SQL 不属于此请求。

realConnectionVerified.description: 仅当 AGENT_JDBC 已在本节点成功完成时为 true；它不代表其他节点、对象权限、性能或导出可行性。

ExportDraftWrite.description: Only private ODP, one explicit table, CSV and one node-local absolute output path belong to this slice.

GatedCsvOptions.description: Any explicit value remains blocked until VS-P0-05 evidence passes.

AgentDataSourceConnectionTestCompletionP.description: 控制面会依据被冻结的 verificationSource 再次核验状态与证据码组合。

compatibilityMode.description: 冻结数据源的 OceanBase 兼容模式；Agent 仅以此选择固定元数据定位与零行读取的标识符引用规则。

payload.description: Operation-specific strict payload schema must replace this structural placeholder before DEV-04 endpoint implementation.

data.description: Resource-specific response schema is completed before its DEV-04 endpoint is implemented.

agentAccessRevoked.description: Whether active Agent credentials or unused enrollment materials were revoked during archival.

objectSummary.description: 从不可变单表导出快照提取的 database.table 摘要；不是完整配置。

stageEvidence.description: 当前增量没有可靠工具阶段映射，不得由状态或时间推断。

progressEvidence.description: 当前增量没有可靠总量与完成量，不返回百分比或 ETA。

reconciliationRequired.description: 保留最后可信状态并在页面附加“状态核对中”。

ownedByCurrentUser.description: 用于显示“我”或“已授权任务”，不披露其他主体标识。

objectSummary.description: 从冻结单表快照提取的 database.table 摘要；不含路径或完整配置。

reconciliationRequired.description: 为 true 时页面必须显示“状态核对中”，而非推断新的终态。

enrollmentMaterial.description: Only returned when issued; never accepted by browser APIs, persisted, or returned by exchange responses.

environmentCheckId.description: 仅在当前 Agent 有待处理固定环境检查时返回控制面生成的不透明标识；空字符串表示无待处理检查。

password.description: 仅允许已认证 Agent 在当前请求的短时内存中使用；不得持久化、回显、记录或用作后续 execution 凭据。
仅允许当前已认证 Agent 的短时内存使用；不得持久化、回显、记录或用于任意导出任务。

requestId.description: Present for every request that enters the HTTP boundary. It is omitted only when the server cannot obtain secure randomness before authentication or persistence and returns REQUEST_ID_UNAVAILABLE.
